assumptions.layout: The shipped source has repr(C) RcBox with strong Cell<usize> first. Rc itself is repr(Rust); first-word casting is tied to the actual measured thin, default-Global representation. Sized T and default allocator are required.
assumptions.provenance_and_cell: The implementation copies a typed NonNull pointer without a pointer-to-integer round trip. Its write targets the actual strong Cell/UnsafeCell region; it does not mutate borrowed Rc storage or payload. This depends on the measured layout and normal Rc aliasing invariants.
assumptions.liveness: A valid borrowed live strong Rc ensures initialized/aligned allocation and positive count. Rc is neither Send nor Sync; unsynchronized races or forged/dangling Rc values are excluded.
assumptions.drop: One successful increment balances one ptr::read copy of the outer Rc. It copies neither RefCell payload nor the inner &mut u64, changes no borrow flag or weak count, and leaves original Rc owned. Global allocator is zero-sized and its clone adds no resource action. Shipped alloc.rs lines51-56 defines Global as a unit struct with derived Copy/Clone, corroborating the no-resource allocator copy.
assumptions.overflow: Both actual stock and manual target IR wrap, store zero and trap with no unwinding on overflow. llvm.expect changes branch guidance; assume(nonzero) relies on the same live-Rc invariant as stock clone.
assumptions.scope: The source has one concrete lamports call. This is not a justification for arbitrary allocator/fat-pointer/compiler versions, exhaustive unsafe Rust correctness, or historical source attribution.
